description: This file contains the implementation of a realtime OpenAI language model context and related aggregator classes for the pipecat project. It includes classes such as OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext, OpenAIRealtimeUserContextAggregator, and OpenAIRealtimeAssistantContextAggregator, which extend existing base classes to add real-time processing, session management, message conversion, and deprecation notices, tailored for managing conversation states and frames in a streaming or interactive environment.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext
classes.description: An extended, real-time capable version of the OpenAI LLM context with session management, message conversion, and deprecation warnings.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeUserContextAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator handling user frames for the realtime OpenAI conversation, managing message updates in real-time streams.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator for assistant output frames, filtering duplicate text, handling function call results, and integrating with realtime service frames.
